summary: A robust candidate that reconciles the CMB and local-ladder H0 (and softens S8) with a small, declared parameter extension. Must survive critique AND beat the baseline by delta_log_likelihood > 0.

pillars.name: early-dark-energy-window
pillars.claim: A brief pre-recombination energy injection raises the inferred local H0 toward 73 while leaving the CMB acoustic scale intact.
pillars.mechanism: A scalar field contributes a small fractional energy density near matter-radiation equality, then dilutes faster than radiation.
assumptions: injection window is short and ends before recombination

declared_limits.reduces_to: standard LambdaCDM as the injected fraction -> 0

falsifiers: no residual imprint on the CMB damping tail
a measured H0_local consistent with 67.4 at high significance

pillars.name: structure-growth-suppression
pillars.claim: A mild late-time growth suppression lowers S8 toward the weak-lensing value without spoiling the CMB.
pillars.mechanism: Scale-dependent growth from the same sector damps sigma8 on lensing scales.

declared_limits.reduces_to: unsuppressed LambdaCDM growth as the coupling -> 0

falsifiers: a measured S8 consistent with 0.83 from independent lensing surveys

notes: Illustrative robust theory artifact in the Phase-1 schema. Uses 2 extra parameters beyond the 3-param baseline; the delta_log_likelihood gain must exceed the BIC parsimony cost.
